sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Alpha Route commenced. Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store, McDonald's Queen Street and Mid City Shopping Centre, all clear. Standing by to ensure presence before moving along.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Check-in at Aotea Square; full scope of the area ensuring no vagrants or concerns present, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols; no activities requiring our assistance.
Welfare check at Atrium on Elliott, making our way up towards Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.
Welfare check at City Convenience Store, all clear.
Check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare checks commenced on all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols and making our way down to the next checkpoint; patrolling down Albert Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Welfare check completed at Hollywood Bakery and Good To Go Supermarket, all clear.
Welfare check commenced around The Cathedral Church and Federal Square, no issues found.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop, all clear.

Check-in at Commercial Bay; full walkthrough completed around the location with welfare checks on all open stores, no issues identified. Standing by to show presence before continuing patrols. Ending Alpha Route.
Check-in at Kiwi Bank; welfare check on the static guard and all stores within the area, all clear.

Arrived at Gore Street; welfare check at Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sienna Cafe, Smiley Mart Convenience Store and all stores at the bottom of Fort Street, all clear. Standing by to show presence before moving along.

Response call from Footlocker reporting a young female vagrant who stole a jacket and told staff she would return for the shoes; last seen running down Queen Street, wearing a blue top and blue shorts.
Patrolling up Queen Street scanning for the reported female.

Arrived at the corner of Queen and Victoria Street; the female was not found. Stopped by Footlocker to retrieve a photo description, but the staff member advised that no one had stolen anything and that no one from the store had called. The call appears to have been a false report made in Footlocker's name.
Welfare check along Durham Street East, all clear.
Welfare check at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Check-in at Chancery Square; full sweep completed within the vicinity, checked in on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Continuing patrols with welfare checks along High Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street; welfare checks on all stores and businesses within the lane, no issues found.
Check-in at the corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Welfare check at Nandos and Munster Inn, all clear.
Welfare check inside Queens Food Court, all clear.
Check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; full scope of the area, no concerns identified, all clear.

Check-in at Aotea Square; full sweep completed, no issues found. Heavy presence from members of the public once again. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls. Ending Echo Route.
Commencing Delta Route. Welfare check completed within Metro Entertainment City, all clear.
Walkthrough of Bledisloe Alley; no issues or vagrant encampment found, all clear.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, all clear.
Welfare check along Elliott Street and Darby Street; checked up on all stores within the area, all clear.
Response call from 77 Convenience Store regarding a male vagrant sitting in front of their store; assistance requested to ask him to move away or to the side.
Arrived at the response location and asked the individual to move along; all clear.
Check-in at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.
Check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare check on all stores completed. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Continuing patrols and making our way back down towards HQ for break.
Welfare check at Liquor City; the store is temporarily closed due to maintenance.
Stationed at Elliott Street ensuring a strong security presence before making our way to HQ; Ops Phone running low.
Standing by outside HQ to show presence before heading upstairs to commence lunch break.
Arrived at HQ; taking lunch break.
Response call from Sian reporting a strong smell of cannabis in front of HQ; immediate attention requested.
Arrived at the front of HQ; the individual smoking cannabis had either moved along or was a passer-by. Stood by outside and scoped the area for any other individuals consuming cannabis, all clear.
Lunch break concluded; continuing standby to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery percentage.
Morning Shift completed; equipment handed over.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.

Commencing patrols on Queen Street, maintaining presence for nearby response calls, businesses and members of the public. Noticed a male vagrant sitting outside Ippondo on Queen Street; advised him he had to move along from the front of the store as management does not approve of vagrants sitting outside. He complied and moved along.

Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street / Timezone; welfare checks on stores between HQ and McDonald's Queen Street, all clear with nothing to report. Standing by for nearby response calls while maintaining a visible presence.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred and no nearby response calls.

Arrived at the bottom of Durham Street East; welfare checks on stores between Victoria Street East and Durham Street East, all clear. Standing by on the lookout for problematic issues, vagrants and nearby response calls.
Leaving standby area; no issues or problematic vagrants within the area.

Arrived at Pocket Park; welfare checks on stores along Queen Street between Pocket Park and Durham Street East, all clear. Standing by for nearby response calls and monitoring for problematic issues or vagrants (15:26–15:50).
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred and no nearby response calls.
Arrived outside Wilson Carpark, Fort Street; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants (15:52–16:20).
Leaving standby area; no issues or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.

Arrived at TK Square; welfare checks on stores within the area. McDonald's Britomart reported that the same male from yesterday's Afternoon Shift who stole from McDonald's Queen Street has also stolen from them today. (Photo on file.) Standing by at TK Square maintaining presence for members of the public (16:25–16:55).
Leaving standby area; no issues or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street / Victoria Street West; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for security presence and nearby response calls.
Leaving standby area; no issues, response calls or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.
Arrived at the Elliott check-in; welfare checks on stores along Elliott Street, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square; welfare checks on stores and businesses, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
While on standby, received a response call from 77 Convenience Store regarding a male vagrant being rude towards their customers; assistance requested to move him along. Heading to the response call.
Arrived at 77 Convenience Store; informed the male vagrant, known as Cowboy, to move along per the manager's request. He complied and moved along. Standing by in case he returns.
The male vagrant has not returned; heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Response call from Snickel Lane regarding two vagrants fighting on Commerce Street; assistance requested. Heading to the response call.
The vagrants had left the Snickel Lane area; standing down and heading back to HQ to commence floor checks.
Arrived at HQ; commencing floor checks.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street; welfare checks complete, no issues reported. Standing by at the Lorne Street fountain for security presence.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at Auckland Library; no issues to report.
Arrived at Aotea Square; a homeless outreach event is under way. Standing by for security presence (19:57–20:20).
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at the Mayoral Drive check-in; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear.
Response call from Localito requesting assistance with a male they were having trouble with.
Arrived at Localito; the shopkeeper advised that the owner had sent someone in to test his response to an intruder — a false alarm.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street; welfare checks on stores within the area.
Welfare checks complete; no issues reported. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby area; heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Afternoon shift concluded; all Auror reports processed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

Early patrol (untimed in log, before 00:48): patrolled Queen Street towards Aotea Square; McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store all clear; full sweep of Aotea Square all clear with a few people around the centre — stood by to show security presence.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues to report.
SkyCity and surrounding areas all clear, no issues to report.
77 Convenience Store, Victoria Street, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Federal Street all clear, no issues to report.
Cathedral Church all clear, no issues to report.
Ace Karaoke all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Albert Mart all clear, no issues to report.
Bus intersection all clear, no issues to report.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues to report.
McDonald's Britomart welfare check completed; all clear, no issues to report.
Customs Street all clear, no issues to report.
Fort Lane all clear, no issues to report.
Jo & Joe all clear, no issues to report.
Wilson Carpark, Gore Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Chancery Square all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
High Street all clear, no issues to report.
Radisson RED Hotel welfare check completed; all clear, no issues to report.
Lorne Street all clear, no issues to report.
Auckland Library full perimeter sweep completed; all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check completed at McDonald's Queen Street; a few vagrants observed outside the store. Maintained a visible security presence in the area as a precaution; no further issues to report.
Queen Street towards HQ all clear. Returned to HQ to charge the Ops Phone, as the battery was at 5%. Standing by for calls.
Received a call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant sleeping inside the store and refusing to leave; responded to the location.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street and spoke with the individual; she complied with security instructions and left the premises without further incident. Returned to HQ to hand over to the morning team.
Shift handover completed with the morning team; no major issues reported during the night shift.

flags: QA: 09:49 Footlocker theft call contradicted on follow-up — staff advised no theft occurred and no call was made from the store; the team noted apparent fake/false report calls coming in.
SENSITIVE: 19:00 report of two vagrants fighting on Commerce Street (Snickel Lane call); parties gone on arrival.
QA: Night shift log has no timestamps before 00:48 — early Queen Street / Aotea Square patrol entries recorded untimed; night handover logged at 06:34.
